address: 189/49 Mu 8, Pratu Chai, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13000, Thailand
bio: The restaurant's vibrant colours stand out from afar. In the backyard, a banyan tree provides pleasant shade. The menu features straightforward and unpretentious seafood, pork and chicken dishes. Expect large servings of seafood that make the mouth water at wallet-friendly prices. We recommend trying their rat na noodles. Closing times may vary, so it's best to arrive early....
